newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Data impact wanes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Data impact wanes.

text.p: A soothing set of Australian wages data failed to have a sustained impact on the local long end of the bond market and saw the 10-year yield spread to the U.S. creep wider again.

Traders said that caution ahead of Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's Humphrey-Hawkins testimony saw local bonds retrace their steps during the afternoon after having rallied on signs of further moderation in enterprise bargaining agreements. However, the data, which showed December quarter wage growth at 4.4 percent after 5.3 percent in the previous quarter, helped to support the short-end, and where spreads were notably tighter to New Zealand.

N.Z. debt remained under a cloud after Tuesday's quarterly employment survey, which confirmed that the economy was growing at a reasonable pace, and saw the 90-day bill rate breach resistance at 7.55 percent.
